📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 08:39 EST, 20 November 2026 | Updated: 07:02 EST, 21 November 2026.

Mikel Arteta has clamped down on Arsenal stars' Fantasy Premier League (FPL) exploits after 'Tzatziki FC', Christos Tzolis' team, 'leaked' team news.

The Arsenal manager admitted he has 'taken measures' to ensure opponents are not given an advantage by his players' selections on the popular game.

Tzolis picked himself as captain of his FPL side prior to the Gunners' 1-0 victory over Liverpool, a clear indication that he would start after recently coming back from injury.

Arteta then caught wind of the situation and Tzolis removed all Arsenal players from his fantasy team for their next game against Hull.

X account FPL Focal identified 'Tzatziki FC' as the Greek winger's team and screenshots of his teams from both game weeks revealed how his picks changed.

On Friday, speaking about this issue, Arteta remarked: 'With Christos, with the squad and with my kids as well. Constantly they are asking me about line-ups as well, because they want to know.

Christos Tzolis picked himself in Fantasy Premier League before starting the Liverpool game.

Tzolis' team, seen here before the Liverpool clash, is called 'Tzatziki FC' and was identified as his side by X account FPL Focal.

'It’s a topic, you know. These are the kind of things that are happening in our society right now and it’s something upcoming.

'We haven’t dealt with it [before] and we need to put new things in place. Obviously confidentiality is something critical because it’s about trust and about what you are trying to do and that should be kept as a huge secret. We’ll take measures to make sure it doesn’t happen.'.

Arteta then confirmed that those measures had already been taken.

Tzolis is a known obsessive of the game, which puts him among 13 million other players who participate every year.

He even quipped after providing an assist against Coventry earlier in the season: 'I will take the three points', referring to the FPL score for doing so.

Chelsea had a similar concern this season, with their players indicating that Joao Pedro was out injured, removing the Brazilian from their FPL teams before his absence was confirmed by the club.

Teams are taking the matter seriously and are keen to ensure any possible advantage their opponents might have regarding team news is nipped in the bud.

Five years ago, Aston Villa stopped their players from participating in FPL after a number of them took Jack Grealish out of their line-ups, notifying eagle-eyed competitors that he was injured.

Mikel Arteta has cracked down on FPL use and 'taken measures' to ensure there are no leaks.

The potential impact of players joining the global GTA 6 mania is another concern for Arteta, with a number of top-flight players already sharing how gripped they will be by the upcoming game.

Bryan Mbeumo posted the loading screen at midnight on Thursday, indicating that he was having a late-night gaming session just days before the Liverpool clash, while Alexander Isak has said he will be hunkering down to play the game.

Declan Rice has previously spoken about how he often games into the early hours after matches when adrenaline is still coursing through him.

And his manager noted: 'We’ll try to find out how much exposure we have to these kinds of games and make sure it’s the right one to be able to perform and focus on what we have to do.'.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il tifo organizzato conferma la presenza il 6 dicembre e precisano che non sarà un rientro definitivo.

Così il Tifo Organizzato, tramite un comunicato pubblicato sull'account Instagram.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

A dicembre abbiamo deciso di regalarci un mese intero di Lazio.

Un anno fa questa sarebbe stata la normalità per il popolo bianco celeste ma purtroppo, un presidente tiranno e la sua pletora di tifosi giallorossi, ci hanno costretto a quell’estremo atto di amore che ci ha portato lontano da casa nostra.

In questi lunghi mesi di lontananza abbiamo capito quanto il consenso di questa protesta poggi su basi molto solide perchè ha continuato ad avere dalla sua parte un popolo che ha liberamente scelto di appoggiarla, di contro i vertici di questa società non hanno fatto assolutamente nulla per riavvicinare la tifoseria continuando ad andare nella direzione esattamente opposta ed il popolo laziale ha continuato a scegliere da che parte stare.

Poche eccezioni si sono distinte, tra tutti sicuramente ci sono mister Gattuso, che più volte ha ribadito di capire ed accettare la nostra decisione esprimendo però il “sogno” di vedere lo Stadio Olimpico pieno della sua gente, e la sua squadra (plasmata ad immagine e somiglianza del mister) che ad ogni trasferta è venuta sotto il settore ospite a prendersi il meritato applauso e sappiamo che ci sono vicini!

Per lui, per la squadra, ma soprattutto per tutti quei bambini e tifosi che hanno aderito alla protesta allontanandosi dallo stadio, a quelli che non sono riusciti ad acquistare il biglietto per il derby ed a tutti i laziali che soffrono lontano dalla propria amata Lazio, abbiamo deciso rendere omaggio entrando il 6 dicembre alla partita Lazio-Atalanta.

Caricheremo così anche i ragazzi prima della stracittadina dando un assaggio dell’ambiente che troveranno il 13 dicembre, dimostrando di essere sempre al loro fianco, perché se lo meritano!

Negli scorsi anni siamo andati ad incitarli a Formello ma ormai quel centro sportivo non lo sentiamo più “casa nostra”, sono state fatte molte amichevoli ed il signor Lotito ha pensato bene di farle a porte chiuse per paura della contestazione, ha fatto chiudere la squadra dentro un bunker fregandosene di tutti quei tifosi che avrebbero voluto vedere ed incitare quei ragazzi che oggi ci stanno regalando grandi soddisfazioni.

Non ne facciamo una questione economica, la sortita del pack scontato per tre partite non ha avuto gli effetti desiderati dall’ufficio marketing, la nostra passione non si compra con gli sconti, la nostra fede non è un prodotto da supermercato, scegliamo noi quando entrare, riprovateci ...sarete più fortunati!

Questo non vuol dire bloccare la contestazione, che per questa partita continuerà dentro lo stadio, o erroneamente pensare che si rientri definitivamente, e’ solo l’ennesima prova di unità e compattezza di un popolo contro un despota.

La protesta proseguirà con le stesse modalità di inizio anno, si continuerà a presenziare solo in trasferta ed ai derby e poi, se e quando lo vogliamo tutti noi, sceglieremo (forse) qualche altra giornata di lazialità.

Recent findings suggest that non si tratta di un passo indietro, altri lo debbono fare, ad iniziare dal tifoso romanista che occupa la sedia del responsabile della comunicazione (al derby come si comporterà!? Tiferà con cuore o continuerà a pensare al portafogli?) noi restiamo fermi sulle nostre posizioni che restano le stesse e non sono minimamente condizionate dall’ottima partenza e dalla meritata posizione in classifica.

Il nostro giudizio completamente negativo su comportamenti del signor Lotito, della gestione vergognosa ed approssimativa della prima società della Capitale, ci fanno restare fermi nella convinzione che un cambio sia urgente per stare al passo con quel mondo del calcio che viaggia ad una velocità tripla rispetto alla nostra Lazio, è doveroso nei confronti di un popolo che vive quotidianamente questo immenso amore e che invece si trova costretto a vivere in un incubo fatto di pressappochismo e botte di fortuna.

Come già detto quando abbiamo deciso di non abbonarci e di seguire la Lazio solo in trasferta, anche questa volta chi vuole restare fuori è libero di farlo, chi invece vuole seguirci si prepari a vivere con noi 90 minuti di puro amore! Portate i bambini, mettetegli una bandiera in mano ed una sciarpa al collo e ditegli che per Natale ci regaliamo tutti un dicembre da laziali con quattro partite che ci riossigeneranno fino al derby di ritorno!

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

C'est une annonce pour le moins inattendue dans le monde du sport tricolore. Ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, Teddy Riner a officialisé sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027 dans une vidéo publiée sur son compte X, tout en lançant son propre mouvement politique intitulé « La France qu'on veut ».

Recent findings suggest that le judoka français de 37 ans se lance ainsi en politique après avoir dominé le judo international. Quintuple champion olympique et onze fois champion du monde, Teddy Riner a bâti un palmarès exceptionnel qui le place au sommet de sa discipline. Alors que son avenir sportif restait au cœur des discussions depuis les Jeux de Paris, le Français surprend en ouvrant un tout autre chapitre personnel. Un virage spectaculaire.

It has been revealed that dans une vidéo publiée ce lundi 9 novembre 2026 sur son compte X, Teddy Riner a pris la parole face caméra afin de lever le voile sur ses intentions pour la prochaine présidentielle. Le judoka de 37 ans a officialisé sa démarche avec des mots simples et directs.

Industry observers note that conscient des réactions que son entrée en politique peut susciter, le quintuple champion olympique a tenu à devancer immédiatement les critiques concernant son manque d'expérience dans les fonctions publiques. Teddy Riner a ainsi déclaré : « Je sais ce qu'on va dire de moi. Il est fou, il n'est pas du sérail, il n'a pas les codes, il n'a jamais fait de politique. Mais posez-vous la question avec moi, qu'est-ce qui est fou aujourd'hui ? Je n'ai pas passé ma vie derrière un public, mais le combat a toujours fait partie de moi. » Une détermination affichée.

Industry observers note that pour concrétiser ses ambitions, le judoka français de 37 ans a également fondé sa propre formation politique ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, baptisée « La France qu'on veut ». Cette prise de parole sur les réseaux sociaux a d'ailleurs été accompagnée d'un entretien accordé au quotidien Le Parisien pour préciser le sens de sa démarche. Dans cet échange, Teddy Riner revendique une volonté de rassemblement sans affiliation partisane, affirmant vouloir devenir un « président qui fédère » sans se situer à droite ou à gauche.

En effet, le champion tricolore a expliqué que sa décision avait mûri dans le sillage direct de l'élan collectif suscité par les Jeux olympiques de Paris 2024. Porté par cette dynamique populaire, il entend désormais transposer cette ferveur sur le blueprint politique. Ainsi, son mouvement politique refuse d'entrer dans les clivages traditionnels pour privilégier une adhésion commune à l'échelle du pays. Un projet ambitieux.

According to recent reports, toutefois, cette ambition politique ne pousse pas Teddy Riner vers la retraite sportive. Sur le blueprint des compétitions, sa dernière apparition individuelle remonte aux Jeux olympiques de Paris en août 2024, suivie d'une participation sous les couleurs du PSG Judo en Ligue des champions en décembre 2024. Malgré cette nouvelle démarche politique, le quintuple champion olympique et onze fois champion du monde de judo demeure bel et bien un athlète en activité.

Au-delà de l'élection présidentielle de 2027, Teddy Riner a ainsi fait part de son souhait de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Los Angeles 2028 si ses futures responsabilités et les Français le lui permettent. Le judoka français lie donc son avenir sportif à la suite de son engagement public, avec en ligne de mire les Jeux olympiques de Los Angeles 2028.

  • Dimanche 8 novembre 2026, l'AS Monaco a été accrochée sur la pelouse du Mans FC (1-1) pour le compte de la 10e journée de Ligue 1.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, auteur de son premier but dans l'élite lors du match nul sur le terrain sarthois, Mamadou Coulibaly a suscité une vive polémique en mimant un geste d'égorgement. Le jeune milieu de l'AS Monaco se retrouve désormais sous la menace directe d'une lourde suspension.

Dimanche 8 novembre 2026, l'AS Monaco a été accrochée sur la pelouse du Mans FC (1-1) pour le compte de la 10e journée de Ligue 1. Si le club du Rocher espérait engranger des points précieux, la rencontre a été marquée par le geste de son joueur de 22 ans.

Titularisé dans l'entrejeu monégasque, Mamadou Coulibaly pensait passer une bonne soirée après avoir ouvert le score à la 40e minute de jeu. Mais la joie d'inscrire son tout premier but en Ligue 1 a rapidement viré au malaise lors de sa célébration. Le milieu monégasque s'est en effet dirigé vers le poteau de corner pour glisser sur les genoux, avant de tirer la langue et de mimer un geste d'égorgement avec son pouce sous la gorge. Un geste polémique.

Ce geste n'est malheureusement pas inédit en Principauté cette saison. En effet, cette célébration reproduit à l'identique celle effectuée par son partenaire de club Paris Brunner face à Strasbourg en septembre dernier, lors de la 4e journée de Ligue 1. Pour ce geste, le jeune attaquant avait été sanctionné par la commission de discipline de la LFP de quatre matches de suspension, dont deux fermes et deux avec sursis.

Sources indicate that D'ailleurs, cette récidive au sein du même effectif met le joueur dans une situation extrêmement délicate. En raison de ce précédent disciplinaire très récent, Mamadou Coulibaly risque une sanction similaire d'au moins deux matches de suspension ferme devant la commission de discipline de la LFP. L'instance disciplinaire devrait se saisir rapidement du dossier pour trancher sur ce comportement. Un coup dur en perspective.

In a recent development, conscient des remous provoqués par son geste, le joueur de 22 ans s'est exprimé devant les journalistes à l'glitch de la rencontre. « Je tiens à m’excuser parce que j’ai cru comprendre que ça avait été mal compris. C’est un geste que j’ai fait par rapport un ami à moi qui m’a conseillé au sujet de la célébration. Je tiens à m'excuser si ça a pu heurter des gens. Maintenant, ce sont des choses qui se font dans d'autres championnats, je n'ai pas pensé que ça pourrait avoir des conséquences négatives », a ainsi déclaré Mamadou Coulibaly en zone mixte au micro des médias après Le Mans-Monaco.

Toutefois, cette justification risque de ne pas suffire auprès de son entraîneur Filipe Luis. Le coach monégasque avait pourtant publiquement averti son groupe en septembre après l'affaire similaire, insistant sur l'exemplarité attendue : « Il a fait une erreur. Il l'a compris tout de suite. Il s'est excusé. Le club prend cette affaire très au sérieux (…). On espère que ça ne se reproduira plus », avait prévenu le technicien en conférence de presse. Au-delà de cette polémique extra-sportive, l'AS Monaco accueillera l'AJ Auxerre au stade Louis-II le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 20h45 pour la 11e journée de Ligue 1.

Une trajectoire fulgurante pour le latéral droit évoluant en deuxième division allemande.

In a recent development, le premier jour du rassemblement à Clairefontaine a réservé un rebondissement de taille dans les rangs tricolores. En effet, Pierre Kalulu a dû déclarer forfait en raison d'une lésion aux ischios du membre inférieur gauche contractée ce week-end avec la Juventus. Face à ce coup dur dans le couloir droit, Zinédine Zidane s'est tourné vers Saël Kumbedi, alors que le joueur de 21 ans avait initialement été retenu par Gérald Baticle avec les Espoirs pour disputer deux rencontres amicales face à l'Italie à Brest et contre l'Angleterre à Bristol.

Comptant déjà neuf sélections avec les Bleuets, le défenseur franchit donc un cap décisif. Pour régler la pénurie à ce poste, le staff technique a délibérément privilégié la jeunesse du joueur de Wolfsburg plutôt que l'expérience de Jonathan Clauss, pourtant performant à Nice du haut de ses 34 ans et de ses quatorze sélections (2 buts). Un choix fort.

Recent findings suggest that avant d'atteindre le groupe de Zinédine Zidane, Saël Kumbedi a connu un parcours jalonné d'étapes intenses. Formé au Havre, le natif de Stains avait rejoint l'Olympique Lyonnais en 2022 contre un chèque d'un million d'euros, découvrant la Ligue 1 à seulement 17 ans sous la houlette de Peter Bosz avant d'enchaîner sous les ordres de Laurent Blanc. Au total, le défenseur a disputé 62 matches sous le maillot des Gones, dont quatre apparitions sur la scène européenne en Ligue Europa lors de l'exercice 2024-2025.

Prêté au VfL Wolfsburg à l'été 2025, le latéral a ensuite été transféré définitivement le 1er janvier 2026 pour un montant de six millions d'euros. Toutefois, l'institution allemande, championne de Bundesliga en 2009 et installée dans l'élite sans discontinuer depuis 1997, a été reléguée en mai 2026 lors d'un barrage contre Paderborn (0-0, 2-1 a.p.). Un coup dur pour la formation allemande. Resté fidèle au club en 2. Bundesliga, Kumbedi est rapidement devenu un titulaire indiscutable sous les ordres de Tobias Strobl, malgré une blessure musculaire lui ayant fait manquer trois matches.

It has been revealed that cette convocation inattendue concrétise la passerelle directe établie entre la sélection A et les moins de 21 ans tricolores. Présent chez les Espoirs, le défenseur Nathan Zézé avait d'ailleurs rapporté le discours tenu par Zinédine Zidane :.

According to recent reports, le parcours de Saël Kumbedi en équipe de France démarre ainsi dans ce contexte de renouvellement. Les Bleus disputeront deux matches de Ligue des nations capitaux au cours de cette trêve internationale. Ils commenceront par un déplacement face à l'Italie à Milan, programmé le jeudi 12 novembre 2026 à 20h45. L'équipe de France recevra ensuite la Turquie à Bordeaux, le dimanche 15 novembre 2026 à 20h45.

Sources indicate that ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, le World 11 masculin de la FIFPRO a été officiellement dévoilé pour récompenser les meilleurs joueurs de la planète. Trois joueurs de Ligue 1 sont présents dans l'équipe idéale de l'année... trois joueurs du Paris Saint-Germain !

Le World 11 masculin 2026 a été configuré selon un schéma tactique très offensif, comprenant un gardien, trois défenseurs, trois milieux et quatre attaquants. Cette formation réunit plusieurs têtes d'affiche du football continental :.

Défenseurs : Pau Cubarsí (FC Barcelone), Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint-Germain), Nuno Mendes (Paris Saint-Germain).

Milieux : Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), Rodri (FC Barcelone), Vitinha (Paris Saint-Germain).

Attaquants : Erling Haaland (Manchester City), Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid), Lionel Messi (Inter Miami), Lamine Yamal (FC Barcelone).

Recent findings suggest that dans ce secteur offensif de gala, Kylian Mbappé s'impose comme l'unique footballeur français récompensé cette année. À ses côtés, Lionel Messi retrouve le World 11 masculin pour la première fois depuis 2023, enregistrant au passage sa 18e nomination. De son côté, le phénomène Lamine Yamal se paye le luxe d'établir un record en devenant le premier joueur à obtenir deux apparitions dans le onze de la FIFPRO avant ses 20 ans. Un record de précocité.

Sources indicate that au tableau des nations, l'Espagne s'affirme comme le pays le plus représenté dans ce onze avec quatre éléments plébiscités, à savoir David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri et Lamine Yamal. La sélection espagnole porte ainsi son total à 53 apparitions dans le FIFPRO World 11 masculin.

In a recent development, À l'échelle des clubs, le Paris Saint-Germain et le FC Barcelone sont les clubs les plus représentés du scrutin masculin. Le club parisien compte en effet trois lauréats avec les deux défenseurs latéraux Achraf Hakimi et Nuno Mendes, ainsi que le milieu de terrain Vitinha. Le FC Barcelone installe de son côté Lamine Yamal, Rodri et Pau Cubarsí, qui bénéficient logiquement du sacre de l'Espagne lors de la Coupe du monde.

Sources indicate that de son côté, le Real Madrid place deux joueurs majeurs dans cette formation idéale avec Jude Bellingham et Kylian Mbappé. L'institution madrilène comptait d'ailleurs au départ cinq nommés potentiels dans les listes globales : Thibaut Courtois, Marc Cucurella, Jude Bellingham et Kylian Mbappé chez les hommes, ainsi qu'Athenea del Castillo chez les femmes.

Recent findings suggest that cette distinction annuelle tire sa valeur de son mode de désignation, où les joueurs jugent directement leurs pairs sur l'ensemble de la planète. En effet, le scrutin masculin a réuni les votes de 19 806 footballeurs professionnels évoluant dans 73 pays différents. Une participation massive. Pour départager les nombreux prétendants et intégrer l'équipe type, la FIFPRO a appliqué une grille d'évaluation rigoureuse dès l'ouverture des votes.

Ainsi, la période de référence retenue pour analyser le rendement sur le terrain s'est étendue du 4 août 2025 au 19 juillet 2026 inclus. Au-delà des seules prestations sportives, une condition éliminatoire imposait aux nommés d'avoir disputé au minimum 30 matches officiels au cours de cet exercice.

Breaking: Inside Diego Gomez's remarkable rise to Premier League's king of the wondergoal: Plucked from a rural Paraguayan village at 13, doing Lionel Messi's running for him at Inter Miami and starring as Brighton's aggressive machine

📅 21 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1470 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 02:00 EST, 21 November 2026 | Updated: 08:07 EST, 21 November 2026.
  • Scattered across the flatlands of Paraguay’s deeply religious Misiones District, where families rely on the land to feed themselves through cattle ranching and cotton production, the people are idolising one of their own.
  • Recent findings suggest that diego Gomez’s ascent from the humble beginnings of a farmer’s son to the heart of a Premier League title race is a Hollywood director’s dream.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TARA ANSON-WALSH, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 02:00 EST, 21 November 2026 | Updated: 08:07 EST, 21 November 2026.

Scattered across the flatlands of Paraguay’s deeply religious Misiones District, where families rely on the land to feed themselves through cattle ranching and cotton production, the people are idolising one of their own.

Recent findings suggest that diego Gomez’s ascent from the humble beginnings of a farmer’s son to the heart of a Premier League title race is a Hollywood director’s dream. While it is a script that has been read many times before, like an old movie or a classic song, it is also one that never gets old.

Recent findings suggest that in this particular iteration, it begins on the dirt tracks of Mburika Reta, which literally translates to the ‘land of donkeys’ in Paraguay’s native Guarani, before winding through the country's capital, Asuncion, and briefly stopping among the palm-lined suburbs of Miami alongside Sergio Busquets and Lionel Messi. It is now gathering pace on England’s south coast, where Brighton find themselves in the unfamiliar territory of hunting down the Premier League champions.

According to recent reports, gomez is the epitome of Fabian Hurzeler’s machine: energetic, aggressive and relentlessly forward-thinking. It is through this collective sense of selflessness that the Seagulls are second in the table, having already defeated both league leaders Arsenal and Manchester City this season. And for Hurzeler’s versatile midfielder, every performance and goal is a reminder of the moments that forged him.

‘He always told me to play forward and, when I have the ball, to have no fear,’ the 23-year-old said last year of his former team-mate Messi.

Cue a spectacular goal from the halfway line against Crystal Palace last month, the Amex crowd growing feverish as the ball sailed over Walter Benitez before crashing into the back of the net.

Diego Gomez pictured as a young teen playing for Libertad (left), is now thriving for Paraguay (right) and one of Brighton's most important players.

Gomez is congratulated by Pascal Gross after scoring a brilliant goal against Brentford.

Another quickly followed against Brentford last weekend, with Gomez barely bringing the ball under control before hooking it into the net from 25 yards out with his supposedly weaker left foot, leaving half of his team-mates clutching their heads in disbelief.

According to recent reports, inevitably Gomez’s rise has not been without its setbacks. It was his mistimed tackle on Desire Doue, stretching out a leg to topple the French winger in the penalty area, that led to the heartache of Paraguay’s World Cup elimination this summer, after Kylian Mbappe slotted home the resulting spot-kick.

Yet rather than be defined by this mistake, Gomez returned home to a hero’s welcome, mobbed by locals as he was paraded through the streets of the usually sleepy San Juan Bautista in an open-top car.

In a recent development, ‘He has the right attitude towards football,’ Hurzeler stated shortly after his arrival. ‘He loves to play. You can feel his passion in every talk with him.’.

It has been revealed that across his 10 appearances this season, Gomez has won 66 duels, more than any Brighton player. His 35 aerial duels won, second behind only Croatian centre back Luka Vuskovic, point to his impressive spring, and he has won 10 tackles, again more than any other Brighton player.

At the other end of the pitch, meanwhile, he has taken the most touches in the opposition box and has scored two goals and recorded two assists this season.

While Gomez’s physique gives the impression of a battering ram, he is surprisingly speedy, recording Brighton’s fastest top speed of the season against Chelsea at 21.01mph.

It has been revealed that but who is this kid who was plucked out of nowhere? Who, at the age of 13, moved four hours away from his rural village to the capital to play football, navigating the bus networks as a child to get to training at FC Libertad before a move to join David Beckham’s glitzy side arrived seven years later?

Gomez, seen with his partner Geraldine Villagra, has taken an unusual route to the top.

Sources indicate that in this case, it was Inter Miami who did the plucking, with Gomez identified by Brighton’s scouting network while he was playing in the MLS in 2024. Gomez formally joined the club as a 21-year-old in a deal worth £11million in January 2025, having agreed the move six months earlier.

Former Brighton centre back Gordon Greer is now the club’s pathway development manager and spoke regularly to Gomez during this time, travelling to Florida to see him during the latter stages of the MLS season. It’s fair to say he liked what he found.

Recent findings suggest that ‘We knew that he would do well because of his application,’ Greer says. ‘He was just a really talented, young, hungry footballer. You could see that he had raw potential, and I think Brighton do that really well. They sign players who have got room to improve.

‘The one thing about Diego that is really impressive is his attitude, his work rate. He’s a really driven character and he’s such a humble kid. You can ask Diego to do certain things and he’ll give it his all, no matter what you ask him to do, whether he’s good at it or not. As a coach, it must be amazing to have someone like that in your team.’.

During his six-month wait for the move, Gomez undertook regular English lessons, tuned in to Brighton’s games on television and spoke to Hurzeler about the areas he could improve before making the switch. All of that left him with a couple of weeks’ head start, which in Premier League terms is massive.

In a recent development, meanwhile, Brighton’s plethora of South American footballers at the time, most notably Julio Enciso, who played alongside him at Libertad, helped him settle quickly. So too did Gomez’s girlfriend, Geraldine Villagra, who moved to Brighton to live with him, while his family regularly visit from Paraguay.

Gomez is the epitome of Fabian Hurzeler’s energetic machine for the Seagulls.

Sources indicate that spending 18 months alongside Messi, Busquets and Luis Suarez was also another notable step in Gomez’s development, despite his understandable initial nerves. He forged a strong understanding with Messi on the pitch and was the engine that enabled the Argentine genius to thrive. Much like at Brighton, though, that did not stop Gomez from producing moments of magic of his own.

Industry observers note that ‘The fact that he had these superstars in the team probably helped him,’ Greer indicates. ‘We don’t have any superstars in our team like Messi, but everyone gives their all.

‘At Inter Miami, Messi was by far the best player, but Diego did a lot of the running for him and had a fantastic season in which he contributed a number of goals and assists. He just worked away at it. Regardless of the kind of environment you put him in, he finds a way through it.’.

The audacity of Gomez’s two recent goals, the strike against Palace that inevitably won the Premier League Goal of the Month award for October and the Brentford one which is firmly in contention for November, almost contradicts that industrious nature. Has Greer been surprised by them?

Recent findings suggest that ‘He scored some really good goals for Inter Miami, but not as good as the ones he’s scored of late for us,’ he says. ‘He wants to achieve big things. It’s no surprise... well, it is a surprise when you see him stick one in the top corner with his left foot!’.

Gomez endeared himself to many when he broke down during a pre-World Cup press conference while speaking about the privilege of representing his country, and he remains deeply aware of where he has come from.

Earlier this year, Brighton chose to extend their UNICEF partnership to Paraguay, with Gomez becoming an ambassador for a programme that aims to develop young people's skills and confidence through sport and will reach thousands of children across the nation, a role he regards as a great honour.

After Paraguay’s elimination from the World Cup, Gomez attended one of the events in Asuncion, where he first plied his trade and where UNICEF will soon roll out the programme.

In a recent development, ‘During his personal time, after coming back from the World Cup, he could have done lots of other things and chose instead to do that,’ Anna Easthope, Brighton’s head of marketing, adds. ‘He realises the impact of meeting kids, giving them inspiration and letting them know that sport is for everyone.’.

If a hero’s welcome followed World Cup elimination, imagine the reception a Premier League title would bring to Misiones.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

L'Olympique Lyonnais a officialisé ce lundi 9 novembre 2026 à 18h la nomination de Carlos Vicens au poste d'entraîneur principal. Libre depuis son licenciement du SC Braga, le technicien espagnol de 43 ans s'est engagé pour un an et demi, soit jusqu'au 30 juin 2028, avec pour objectif principal de décrocher une qualification européenne en mai prochain.

Pour relancer l'équipe, la direction de l'OL a choisi de miser sur un profil au bagage formateur reconnu. En effet, avant son expérience au Portugal, Carlos Vicens a passé huit saisons au sein de Manchester City. Vainqueur de la FA Youth Cup en 2020 avec les U18 du club anglais, l'Espagnol est ensuite devenu l'adjoint de Pep Guardiola entre 2021 et 2025. Un passage formateur au plus haut niveau.

Industry observers note that fort de cette riche expérience, le nouvel entraîneur lyonnais s'était ensuite lancé comme numéro un au SC Braga lors de la saison 2025-2026. Une aventure réussie avec une quatrième place en championnat portugais et une demi-finale de Ligue Europa, avant un licenciement survenu le 20 octobre 2026 après trois défaites consécutives.

Dans son communiqué, le club rhodanien explique son choix : « La direction a ainsi retenu le profil de Carlos Vicens, dont l'approche du jeu, l'exigence et l'importance accordée au développement des joueurs correspondent pleinement aux orientations définies par le club ». Cette arrivée met un terme au feuilleton de la succession sur le banc rhodanien. L'OL devait en effet trouver un remplaçant à Paulo Fonseca, récemment parti pour le Sporting CP après 83 matches dirigés à Lyon, contre une indemnité estimée à 5 millions d'euros. Durant cette période délicate, Jorge Maciel avait assuré l'intérim. Toutefois, les difficultés sportives ont rapidement ressurgi en championnat.

Industry observers note that après un match nul contre la Real Sociedad (1-1) en Ligue Europa, les Lyonnais se sont inclinés à Brest (0-2) dimanche 8 novembre 2026 lors de la 10e journée de Ligue 1. Une rencontre disputée en Bretagne pendant laquelle Carlos Vicens a visité les installations du club. L'Espagnol a ainsi découvert son futur cadre de travail avant de parapher son contrat de dix-huit mois.

Sources indicate that pour mener à bien sa mission, Carlos Vicens est accompagné par quatre adjoints, dont son assistant Mario Enguidanos (34 ans) et Lander Iza Garcia (30 ans), chargé de la performance. Dans un souci de continuité, le club a également maintenu des cadres techniques déjà en place : « Jorge Maciel conservera ses fonctions d'entraîneur adjoint, dans une volonté de continuité et avec la pleine confiance de la direction du club. Adrien Tarascon poursuivra également sa mission de responsable du développement individuel des joueurs, tandis que Sébastien Hamel, jusqu'ici entraîneur des gardiens de la Pro 2 depuis janvier 2025, rejoindra définitivement le staff. ».

Le technicien espagnol n'aura que peu de temps pour prendre ses marques. Carlos Vicens dirigera sa première séance d'entraînement mardi 10 novembre au matin avant d'être présenté aux médias à 15 heures. Au-delà des présentations, le travail tactique débutera sans attendre. Le premier match officiel de Carlos Vicens avec l'OL aura lieu le samedi 21 novembre 2026 face au LOSC au stade Pierre-Mauroy lors de la 11e journée de Ligue 1.

According to recent reports, matias Vecino si prepara a tornare in campo dopo l’intervento e alcuni mesi lontano dal calcio giocato. L’ex centrocampista di Lazio e Inter, che ha risolto il contratto con il Celta Vigo, racconta di stare recuperando e indica metà dicembre come il momento in cui conta di essere pronto. A Gianlucadimarzio.com ha detto: «Sto bene, sto recuperando. Mi sto preparando per il ritorno in campo».

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

In a recent development, vecino ha ricordato le difficoltà incontrate all’inizio del percorso. Industry observers note that il centrocampista è tornato a Roma con la famiglia e prosegue il lavoro insieme al suo staff. «Siamo tornati a Roma con la mia famiglia, sto facendo un bel lavoro con il mio staff. Il classe ’91 ha indicato anche quando pensa di poter essere pronto: «Per metà dicembre sarò pronto. Sono molto ansioso di tornare, sto già lavorando sul campo con il pallone e tutto procede per il verso giusto. Poi vedremo quali opportunità potranno presentarsi».

In a recent development, «Sarebbe bello tornare in Serie A perché è un campionato che conosco e nel quale mi conoscono. Vedremo quello che succederà», ha dichiarato. Ha poi aggiunto: «Sono aperto anche ad altre opzioni. Dipende dalle possibilità che capiteranno».

In a recent development, prima di valutare le occasioni che si presenteranno, il centrocampista vuole completare il recupero: «L'importante è stare bene, continuare a recuperare e tornare al cento per cento. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

En pleine confiance, Marc Cucurella a profité de son passage sur les ondes espagnoles pour désigner le Real Madrid comme la meilleure équipe du continent. Le latéral gauche estime en effet que la formation madrilène propose actuellement le meilleur football en Europe, balayant au passage les récentes critiques subies par le club.

Recent findings suggest that invité au micro de Juanma Castaño dans l'émission nocturne El Partidazo de COPE, diffusée sur la station Cadena COPE dans la nuit du 9 au 10 novembre 2026, Marc Cucurella a placé le club madrilène comme la meilleure équipe d'Europe. Le joueur estime que la formation espagnole propose actuellement le meilleur football, au-dessus de n'importe quel rival, alors même que le club était la cible de nombreuses critiques quelques semaines auparavant. Une nette montée en puissance. Il faut dire que le Real Madrid reste désormais sur une série impressionnante de huit victoires consécutives toutes compétitions confondues.

Dans ce même entretien, l'international espagnol a également pris la défense de son coéquipier Vinícius Júnior face aux critiques. D'ailleurs, Marc Cucurella a tenu à mettre en avant Arda Güler, qu'il considère comme le joueur madrilène le plus impressionnant cette saison.

Interrogé sur la concurrence européenne et plus particulièrement sur le statut du PSG, le défenseur a placé sans hésiter le Real Madrid devant le club français. Tout en reconnaissant la solidité du projet et la qualité évidente de l'effectif du PSG, il voit l'équipe madrilène un cran au-dessus en ce moment. Une hiérarchie assumée. Toutefois, le joueur a reconnu avec franchise ne pas regarder les matches du club parisien ni son duel face au FC Barcelone, par manque de temps et pour s'occuper de ses enfants.

Une vie de famille bien remplie qui l'éloigne des matches à la télévision, mais qui ne l'empêche pas de maintenir une analyse tranchée sur le rapport de force actuel. Ainsi, malgré les louanges adressées au club de la capitale française, le joueur maintient fermement sa position en faveur du Real Madrid.

Sources indicate that régulièrement aligné avec l'équipe d'Espagne, le latéral gauche prépare un rendez-vous crucial en Ligue des nations. La Roja disputera en effet la cinquième journée de la compétition le jeudi 12 novembre 2026 sur le terrain de la République tchèque.

Après cette parenthèse internationale, le Real Madrid retrouvera le championnat. Le prochain rendez-vous en club du Real Madrid aura lieu le samedi 21 novembre 2026 au stade Santiago-Bernabéu face au Celta Vigo, à l'occasion d'une nouvelle journée de Liga.

Palmer and Rogers complete 12-minute rescue mission to save Chelsea

📅 09 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 23 min read (4620 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~23 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Xabi Alonso needed the cavalry – and referee Jarred Gillett – to stop Chelsea making a quick exit from the Carabao Cup and, boy, did they come up trumps for him.
  • Chelsea had looked to be heading out of the competition shortly after half-time, but, in Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers, Alonso has a cheat code that is capable of masking even the worst defending.
  • According to recent reports, alonso’s side have shared 26 goals in the five games they have played this season.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Xabi Alonso needed the cavalry – and referee Jarred Gillett – to stop Chelsea making a quick exit from the Carabao Cup and, boy, did they come up trumps for him.

Chelsea had looked to be heading out of the competition shortly after half-time, but, in Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers, Alonso has a cheat code that is capable of masking even the worst defending.

According to recent reports, alonso’s side have shared 26 goals in the five games they have played this season. It has certainly been an entertaining start by Chelsea’s latest manager.

Industry observers note that palmer, Rogers and Pedro Neto stepped off the substitutes’ bench to complete a stunning rescue mission against Leeds United. Palmer scored twice, Neto once and Rogers helped himself to at least a hat-trick of assists. He claimed it was four, but the record books may say three.

According to recent reports, when it was revealed Palmer had been awarded the player of the match, Rogers responded by saying: “Mate, I got four assists. I can’t believe that! That’s mental. He scored a pen!”.

"Mate, I got four assists!" "That is criminal!" Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer arguing over the POTM award! 🤣 pic.twitter.com/X2PkPnSGDk.

Industry observers note that chelsea had looked down and out, when, just three minutes after Alonso’s quadruple half-time change, Leeds doubled their lead. But four goals in an incredible 12-minute spell turned the tie on its head and it was Alonso’s substitutes who Chelsea had to thank.

Palmer, with some help from Gillett, was the first to come to the home side’s rescue. Four minutes after Brenden Aaronson had put Leeds 2-0 up, Gillett pointed to the penalty spot after Daniel James had stood on the foot of Pep Chavarría.

Industry observers note that it looked like a harsh decision on Leeds and proved to be almost as major of a game-changer as Alonso’s substitutions. Palmer stepped up to score the resulting penalty.

Industry observers note that cole Palmer pulls one back for Chelsea from the spot! 🎯 pic.twitter.com/BUv6h1wTPQ.

Industry observers note that “Nobody in the stadium, not one player was asking for a penalty and he gave the penalty,” Daniel Farke, the Leeds manager, said. “All of a sudden their players came into the game. The momentum was on their side. Situations can change the whole momentum of the game.”.

Stamford Bridge sensed a comeback and in the 55th minute, Rogers nudged the ball into the path of Palmer who produced a brilliant curling finish to beat Michael Zetterer, the Leeds goalkeeper.

TWO goals in TWO minutes for Cole Palmer and Chelsea are level! 🥶 pic.twitter.com/sgDd3YUgA6.

Recent findings suggest that reece James then went close, before Neto completed the turnaround on the hour mark. Palmer found Rogers, who in turn picked out Neto and he sent Stamford Bridge wild by sending his shot into the corner of the net.

In a recent development, "This is a comeback of comebacks!" Pedro Neto scores and Chelsea have turned it around eleven minutes after going 2-0 down! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/FTPuWcFqEX.

As Farke waited to make a quadruple substitution of his own, Danny Welbeck got in on the act by collecting the ball from Rogers, spinning and scoring.

Class from Danny Welbeck 😤 pic.twitter.com/FUFKxlzXDz.

That should have been that and the atmosphere could not have been more different from half-time, when Chelsea fans had booed off their side after watching them fall a goal behind.

Reggie Watson, Chelsea’s 16-year-old debutant, Malo Gusto, Estêvão Willian and Jamie Gittens were hooked at half-time by Alonso, who said: “For sure, I take responsibility for all of them. No player to blame. It’s the decisions that we took.

Sources indicate that “I know that probably I haven’t taken the right decisions for them to show their best level. It’s something that I will analyse and learn from. So it’s my responsibility and we had to make decisions at half-time. And we have seen another second half with another quality.”.

Goalkeeper Mike Penders was one of the nine changes made by Alonso. He produced a superb double-save to first keep out Aaronson and then recover to tip Tarik Muharemovic’s header out from the corner.

Conor Coady was impressed with that Mike Penders double save in the first half 👏 pic.twitter.com/6NJqFDvnzk.

Sources indicate that but the Belgian flapped at the corner, which gave Harry Wilson a second chance to get his delivery right. And he did just that by finding Muharemovic at the back post to head the ball into the net.

Valentín Barco survived Alonso’s changes, but was partly at fault for Leeds’s second goal just after the break. He lost the ball and Ethan Ampadu galloped away from Rogers before crossing. Lukas Nmecha got the slightest of touches and Aaronsen smashed the ball into the net.

"Chelsea cut apart AGAIN !" Brenden Aaronson makes it 2-0 to Leeds 🔥 pic.twitter.com/LlJNpqXHav.

The substitutes then took over, as Chelsea shocked the visitors before Leeds substitute Dominic Calvert-Lewin gave his team hope by reducing the deficit with 15 minutes remaining.

According to recent reports, any thoughts of a Leeds comeback were swiftly erased, however, as Barco netted his first Chelsea goal from a Rogers pass, which may have taken a slight touch to deny him a fourth assist in the record books. Welbeck added a sixth in time added on.

Valentín Barco gets Chelsea a FIFTH! 🫨 pic.twitter.com/XnhgvhBpL9.

On the defeat by Chelsea, Farke remarked: “The referee had the idea to give a penalty. No one in the stadium was asking for it, no one of their players was asking for it, but he spotted a situation where he thought he would give a penalty.

Industry observers note that “All of a sudden they scored the goal, then their players came into the game at half-time, the whole stadium after being relatively quiet for 60 minutes they of course were there then. The momentum was all of a sudden on their side. In football small situations can change the whole momentum of a game and this happened.”.

According to recent reports, "100% I meant it!" 😅Morgan Rogers states he is really enjoying his football after he helped Chelsea beat Leeds 6-3 in the Carabao Cup! 🔵 pic.twitter.com/7uUQb6eIla.

According to recent reports, here’s a reminder of the assist in question. Did Rogers mean it? Let us know in the comments beneath this live blog...

Sources indicate that TWO goals in TWO minutes for Cole Palmer and Chelsea are level! 🥶 pic.twitter.com/sgDd3YUgA6.

According to recent reports, "Mate, I got four assists!" "That is criminal!" Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer arguing over the POTM award! 🤣 pic.twitter.com/X2PkPnSGDk.

On the message from the manager at half-time, Palmer told Sky Sports: “Just up the intensity, play a bit more, become more alive because I think the first half was flat, everyone agreed in the changing room, so we stepped up.

Industry observers note that asked whether Alonso’s message was delivered calmly, he said: “At the start, but then he got a bit angry. But it was alright.”.

Recent findings suggest that on Chelsea’s half-time changes, Conor Coady said on Sky Sports: “I think the credit goes down to [Alonso]. He made a bit of a statement by doing that at half-time. Four subs is a lot to do at half-time but it was needed. Listen, we said about the first half that it was kind of like the players hadn’t played with each other, and then the big guns came on... They were electric at times.”.

A crazy match which was decided by Chelsea’s superb substitutes. Alonso took action at half-time and was rewarded with six goals in a madcap second half. Palmer hauled Chelsea back into the game, Rogers collected a handful of assists and Neto scored the go-ahead goal. You wonder what this match will do for the likes of Estevao and Gittens, though.

Chelsea 6 Leeds United 3 (Welbeck) Pure reflexes from Welbeck, who diverts Barco’s wild effort beyond Zetterer.

It has been revealed that palmer has the hat-trick ball on his mind and attempts an audacious chip but just gets his angles wrong. Any guesses who laid on the chance? Rogers. Of course.

Industry observers note that fans in the away end have resolved they have seen enough and are now heading towards the exits. Stach attempts to launch a counter but his raking cross-field ball is far too heavy.

Rogers drifts out to the left and wins Chelsea a valuable corner. James walks over to take it to rapturous applause from supporters there.

Leeds look to break but Wilson mistimes his run and is caught offside.

There will be six minutes of time added on.

Recent findings suggest that chance! Okafor darts inside of Neto and spins in a teasing ball to the back post but neither Calvert-Lewin nor Tanaka are able to reach it.

Shouts for a Leeds penalty fail to pique the interest of referee Gillett. Gudmundsson was felled on the left of the box but the contact looked minimal.

A tap on Barco’s head from Wilson provokes some histrionics from the Argentine but Jarred Gillett calms all parties down.

Leeds are still pushing. Stach’s effort from eight yards out is closed down before Tanaka’s strike from the edge of the box is smothered by James.

Alonso goes into the book, apparently for straying too far outside of his technical area.

Chelsea 5 Leeds United 3 (Barco) Rogers lays on his fourth assist of the match, driving towards the byline before flashing a searching ball across the face of goal which Barco spears past Zetterer at the far post. That should be that, right?

In a recent development, valentín Barco gets Chelsea a FIFTH! 🫨 pic.twitter.com/XnhgvhBpL9.

We could be in for a blockbuster finish.

Gudmundsson replaces debutant Bard down Leeds’ left.

Chelsea 4 Leeds United 3 (Calvert-Lewin) Game back on? Okafor is afforded far too much space down the left by a tiring Chelsea back line and his cross finds Calvert-Lewin who plants the ball past Penders to reduce the deficit to just one goal. What a tie this has turned into!

Leeds win a corner, which falls to Stach on the edge of the box but his effort is charged down.

It has been revealed that it will be a source of acute anguish for Farke that Chelsea’s fourth goal came before he could make his four changes: Stach, Calvert-Lewin, Tanaka and Okafor eventually replace James, Nmecha, Longstaff and Aaronson. Conversely, it should be to Alonso’s credit that he took action early - his substitutes have decided this tie.

Sources indicate that chelsea 4 Leeds United 2 (Welbeck) Rogers gallops on to a simple ball down the right channel and his cutback (towards Palmer) is picked up by Welbeck who spins before firing beyond Zetterer, leaving three Leeds defenders sprawled in front of him. He cares not, and absorbs the love of the crowd in the near corner.

Class from Danny Welbeck 😤 pic.twitter.com/FUFKxlzXDz.

Recent findings suggest that palmer goes close after having found a yard of space on the edge of the box. His strike spears through a thicket of limbs in Leeds’ box but Zetterer pulls off a strong save to deny the Englishman a quickfire hat-trick.

Sources indicate that chelsea 3 Leeds United 2 (Neto) Just 11 minutes after going 2-0 down, Chelsea find themselves ahead. Palmer threads a through-ball through the middle for Rogers, who slides in front of his marker to an open Neto who sweeps the ball beyond Zetterer. Leeds punished for leaving themselves two vs two at the back there.

In a recent development, "This is a comeback of comebacks!" Pedro Neto scores and Chelsea have turned it around eleven minutes after going 2-0 down! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/FTPuWcFqEX.

Chelsea have got their tails up and Palmer almost lays on a go-ahead goal but James cannot turn in his cross from the left.

Chelsea 2 Leeds United 2 (Palmer) Wow! Palmer has turned this game on its head. And it’s so, so simple. Acheampong’s throw-in is knocked down by Rogers into the path of Palmer who works in from the right, passing the ball around a Leeds defender and past a rooted Zetterer.

TWO goals in TWO minutes for Cole Palmer and Chelsea are level! 🥶 pic.twitter.com/sgDd3YUgA6.

According to recent reports, chelsea 1 Leeds United 2 (Palmer) Palmer makes no mistake. He goes right, and while Zetterer guesses the right way he cannot get there and Chelsea are back in business.

Sources indicate that cole Palmer pulls one back for Chelsea from the spot! 🎯 pic.twitter.com/BUv6h1wTPQ.

According to recent reports, chavarria is caught by James in the box and the referee points to the spot. That came from nowhere.

It has been revealed that chelsea 0 Leeds United 2 (Aaronson) Amapadu deserves so much credit here. He steals the ball from Barco high, bursts beyond Rogers on the right and while Nmecha cannot turn in his cutback, Aaronson arrives late to stroke the ball past Penders and double Leeds’ lead.

"Chelsea cut apart AGAIN !" Brenden Aaronson makes it 2-0 to Leeds 🔥 pic.twitter.com/LlJNpqXHav.

Alonso resolves he has seen enough and rings the changes at the interval. Palmer, Rogers, James and Neto enter the fray in place of Estevao, Watson, Gittens and Gusto.

According to recent reports, massive cheers from the Chelsea fans at half-time, as Cole Palmer, Pedro Neto, Morgan Rogers and Reece James have all come on to warm up and are stripped off ready to play. Alonso is sending on the cavalry.

The delayed kick-off has knocked us out of kilter with tonight’s Champions League matches, but here are the live scores:.

Boos at half-time from the Chelsea fans. Their team were pretty awful, but booing so early in the season. Really?

According to recent reports, there is only one minute of time added on and Watson earns himself a booking for a late challenge on Wilson before the half-time whistle is blown. It will be interesting to see how long Alonso waits before turning to his bench.

Justin, James and Wilson have got a lot of joy down Leeds’ right, rotating in Chavarria’s orbit. It has been difficult for Chelsea to pin them down and Gittens’ attacking threat has been blunted as he attempts to track their movements.

It has been revealed that better from Chelsea. Watson does well to regain possession high and Estevao takes over, darting towards the by-line. His cutback is directed towards Welbeck but he is beaten to the ball by a Leeds toe and it is played behind for a corner which comes to nothing.

Chelsea are really struggling to build up a head of steam, with individual mistakes proving costly.

Gittens and Estevao both end up on the left and the former works infield before firing a shot at Zetterer which the German parries behind for a corner. Perhaps Chelsea’s most dangerous moment of the half.

The corner is played short with the ball eventually falling to Barco on the edge of the box but his mis-hit effort trickles wide.

It has been revealed that gittens rescues an overhit Acheampong cross and finds Barco on the edge of the box, but the Argentine’s effort is charged down. Leeds spring a counter and their sweeping move up field earns them a corner.

Wilson floats another delivery to the back post to Muharemovic, but he cannot replicate his earlier goal.

Sources indicate that farke will be delighted with what he has seen so far. It is all well and good Chelsea allowing Leeds the ball, but they have to break incisively when openings arise, and they have not done that.

Significant chance for Leeds! James bursts down the right and the Welsh winger dinks in a cross to the far post which Justin cannot get past Acheampong, but while Longstaff is first to the second ball, he can only sky the shot over the bar.

Leeds’ goal has stirred something inside them and they look motivated to score a second. Ampadu releases a long throw from the left which ricochets off a couple of players before rolling out for a Chelsea goal-kick.

Chelsea 0 Leeds United 1 (Muharemovic) Set-pieces have been a massive feature of Leeds’ game this season and here they take the lead with the simplest of corner routines. Wilson floats the ball to the back post where Muharemovic is waiting, unmarked, and he loops a header over Penders into the net. Such a shame for the Chelsea keeper as he had just pulled off a stunning double-save.

According to recent reports, "The set-piece routine does it again!" Tarik Muharemović puts Leeds in front against Chelsea! ⚡️ pic.twitter.com/UxeJ3xgL56.

Barco slips on the far side and in doing so concedes a corner rather comically, to the delight of the travelling supporters. The delivery is met by Lacroix and Leeds are unable to create anything from the second phase of the set-piece.

Sources indicate that there is an intriguing duel developing down Chelsea’s right as Bard looks to contain Estevao. The French wing-back has done a decent job so far.

Estevao attempts to free himself of Bard’s clutches and drifts inside, Chavarria then almost picks him out with a cross from the left but Leeds just about clear their lines.

Justin plays in a cultured through-ball from a wide-right position to James but Chavarria does well to snuff it out. Leeds are making the pitch as big as possible and spaces are beginning to open up as they did at Fulham on the opening weekend.

Although Penders’ shot-stopping has not yet been tested, he has shown some nifty footwork, sweeping up any loose balls that make it past Chelsea’s back three/five.

Big chance! Chelsea spring a surprise attack as Chavarria sets Gittens away down the left. He works the ball infield to Welbeck who lays on a great chance for Estevao but Justin darts back to take the ball off the Brazilian’s toes. A brilliant piece of last-ditch defending.

Gittens gets a shot away, a tame effort straight at Zetterer from 22 yards out as he cuts in from the left. The correct intent, though.

Recent findings suggest that leeds look to circulate the ball across their back line. As mentioned pre-match, Chelsea will not mind letting their opponents get on the ball as they set out-of-possession traps. Aaronson eventually dribbles off the pitch on the far side.

Sources indicate that chelsea’s Argentine midfielder, Valentin Barco, is being booed by the Leeds fans every time he touches the ball. Barco will already be used to getting that treatment, as it has even happened to him while he’s been a substitute this season.

In other news, there’s a real Borussia Dortmund vibe to this Leeds away kit.

Leeds supporters boo Argentina World Cup squad member Barco’s every touch, and another Leeds foul, this time Justin on Gittens, prompts a second Chelsea free-kick.

It has been revealed that A couple of early touches for Watson who plays a neat pass around the corner. Ampadu then lands a late tackle on Lacroix and Chelsea earn a free-kick in their own half.

Sources indicate that although there are still some empty seats, we are finally under way. Chelsea in their customary all blue, kicking from right to left. Leeds in their yellow away strip.

Chelsea and Leeds emerge from the tunnel, led out by Colwill and former Chelsea defender Ampadu. Here’s a reminder of the teams in full:.

As recently as March, a giant mural of Estêvão Willian appeared on the side of a building outside Stamford Bridge as the teenager threatened to become Chelsea’s number one poster boy.

He may no longer hold top billing outside the club, following a summer in which Chelsea spent a club-record £117m on Morgan Rogers to complete a fearsome front three alongside Cole Palmer and João Pedro.

A giant mural of the Brazilian teenager appeared on the side of a building close to Stamford Bridge in March.

It has been revealed that but inside Stamford Bridge, nothing has changed. Estêvão remains one of Chelsea’s star boys and is part of an “untouchable” group of players that also includes Palmer, Rogers and Pedro. Sources believe Estêvão is a player the club will look at rewarding with an improved contract in the coming months.

Having already earned his Chelsea “untouchable” status, the next challenge for the 19-year-old winger – once nicknamed “Messinho” – is to make himself undroppable.

Industry observers note that estêvão may not be a perfect fit for Xabi Alonso’s three-at-the-back formation that features two 10s – Palmer and Rogers – behind a striker. But the boy from Brazil is certainly not being squeezed out and Chelsea’s manager has spoken of the need to be flexible.

Chelsea Penders; Gusto, Acheampong, Lacroix, Colwill, Chavarria; Watson, Barco; Estevao, Gittens; Welbeck.

Substitutes Martinez, Hato, Fofana, James, Neto, Palmer, Quenda, Rogers, Pedro.

Leeds United Zetterer; Justin, Bijol, Muharemovic; James, Ampadu, Longstaff, Bard; Wilson, Aaronson; Nmecha.

Substitutes Trafford, Gudmundsson, Elvedi, Bogle, Tanaka, Stach, Okafor, Calvert-Lewin, Bahoya.

It has been revealed that much has been made of Chelsea’s willingness to let the opposition have the ball under Xabi Alonso, but tonight they will likely be forced to dictate proceedings. In Leeds, they face one of only two sides who have completed fewer passes than them in the Premier League.

1. Ian Hamilton in 1967: 16 years, four months and 15 days2. Kingsley Whiffen in 1967: 16 years, five months and six days3. Reggie Walsh in 2025: 16 years, six months and 11 days4. Reggie Watson in 2026: 16 years, seven months and 14 days5. Tommy Langley in 1974: 16 years, nine months and one day.

Asked how he will approach the Carabao Cup this season, Daniel Farke stated: “We’ll try to win it. That’s the quickest way to Europe and to some glory. Of course knowing that the Premier League will always have the priority and knowing that we are as successful as possible there, especially to reach our first goal to establish ourselves [at] this level.

“We are not the favourites to win the Carabao Cup, we know this. Challenging, difficult games, but of course we travel to London in order to go through in the next round without doing anything stupid at this stage of the campaign because you also have to rotate a bit more and integrate a few new players. Nevertheless, we want to be at our best and anyhow possible we also want to go through to the next round.”.

According to recent reports, tonight represents an opportunity for 16-year-old Reggie Watson to announce himself at senior level. The central-midfielder caught Alonso’s eye during pre-season when the Spaniard noted of him: “Reggie Watson, a great midfielder. He thinks, he’s very collective, he’s very generous on the effort, intelligent with the ball”.

“For his age, I’m really impressed with him.”.

Dan James passes a late fitness test to make Daniel Farke’s starting XI.

Mis à la porte par l'écurie Haas avec effet immédiat, Esteban Ocon a pris la parole ce mardi 10 novembre 2026. Le pilote français a tenu à adresser un message sobre à ses supporters ainsi qu'à l'ensemble du paddock de la Formule 1.

Cette prise de parole intervient une semaine après l'officialisation de son éviction, actée le mardi 3 novembre 2026 pour les quatre derniers Grands Prix de la saison 2026. Une rupture brutale alors qu'Esteban Ocon, 30 ans, occupait la 16e place du classement des pilotes avec 7 points, contre 20 points pour son coéquipier Oliver Bearman.

According to recent reports, sur son compte Instagram, le vainqueur du Grand Prix de Hongrie 2021 a publié un texte sobre, sans la moindre rancœur envers sa direction. Esteban Ocon a préféré remercier chaleureusement les personnes qui l'ont soutenu durant cette épreuve, rappelant son attachement indéfectible pour sa discipline.

Le pilote tricolore compte 199 engagements et 198 départs en Formule 1, ainsi que 4 podiums en carrière.

In a recent development, L'aventure s'est pourtant terminée dans la tourmente. En effet, tout s'est accéléré le samedi 31 octobre 2026 lors du Grand Prix de Mexico sur le circuit de l'Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Mis à l'écart soudainement après un différend interne lors des essais libres du vendredi, le Français avait alors cédé sa place au réserviste japonais Ryo Hirakawa. Un coup dur.

Une séparation était déjà programmée fin septembre 2026, mais l'accord prévoyait initialement qu'il termine la saison. Toutefois, le directeur de l'écurie, Ayao Komatsu, a affirmé avoir pris cette décision anticipée dans le meilleur intérêt de la structure. Haas a d'ailleurs aligné le rookie brésilien Rafael Câmara, déjà engagé pour 2027, dès le Grand Prix de São Paulo le week-end du 8 novembre 2026.

Désormais sur la touche, Esteban Ocon fait face à un futur incertain. À trois manches de la fin de la saison 2026, il ne dispose d'aucun baquet titulaire confirmé pour 2027. Au-delà des doutes contractuels, sa passion et son amour pour la Formule 1 restent aussi forts que jamais.

Le prochain rendez-vous du championnat du monde de Formule 1 2026 sera le Grand Prix de Las Vegas, 21e manche de la saison, programmé du 19 au 21 novembre 2026 sur le Las Vegas Strip Circuit.

'"Tough times don't last, tough people do" - my guy (Julian Edelman) told me this one!' Kane added, quoting the NFL icon.

It has been revealed that 'Thank you for all the messages! Alles gut (red heart emoji, strong arm emoji).'.

Speaking post-match, Bayern sporting director Max Eberl revealed that Kane has suffered ligament damage.

Sources indicate that A Bayern club statement confirmed the blow, reading: 'Harry Kane suffered a tear of the syndesmosis ligament in his left ankle in Bayern Munich’s Bundesliga home match against 1. FC Köln on Friday evening.

'This was confirmed by an examination by Bayern Munich’s medical department.

'The 33-year-old will therefore be out for the next few months. Get well soon Harry.'.

Kane's absence will be a major blow for Bayern, with the Ballon d'Or winner having scored ten goals in 16 matches so far this season.

Bayern, who are already without Luis Diaz, Saibari and Serge Gnabry, also saw Michael Olise come off at half-time.

The German giants later confirmed Olise had suffered a 'contusion of the forefoot', with the Frenchman set to undergo treatment in the coming days.

It remains to be seen whether Kane - who became England's most-capped player last week when making his 126th appearance in the 2-1 win over Croatia - is at risk of missing the Nations League quarter-final against Norway in March.

Vincent Kompany, who was back in the dugout for the first time since his collapse last month, admitted other players will have to step up for Bayern in the absence of star names such as Kane.

'These are world-class players, you can't replace them, but we have the mentality and we have to bring that now,' Kompany said, as per Bild.

'We need incredible performances from players who may not yet be used to this pressure at FC Bayern.

Bayern were held to a 1-1 draw by Cologne on Vincent Kompany's return to the touchline.

'We will all try together to make this situation a positive one for ourselves. FC Bayern does this time and time again, and that's what we want to do now too.'.

Bayern were ultimately held to a 1-1 draw by Cologne, with Tottenham loanee Mikey Moore giving the visitors a shock first half lead at the Allianz Arena.

Nathaniel Brown drew Bayern level before half-time, but the hosts were unable to find a winner on Kompany's return.

The draw gives Borussia Dortmund the chance to move to the top of the Bundesliga table on Saturday.

Plongée dans une crise sportive historique, la direction mancunienne a décidé d'agir sans attendre la fin de la semaine pour redresser la situation.

Le technicien de 45 ans a définitivement quitté les installations du club vers 10h18 après avoir été notifié de son renvoi. Une matinée particulièrement expéditive pour l'Anglais. Michael Carrick a en effet été informé en personne de cette décision par le directeur général Omar Berrada et le directeur du football Jason Wilcox. Ce dénouement fait suite directe à un sommet crucial tenu la veille à Monaco entre Sir Jim Ratcliffe et la famille Glazer, réunis par visioconférence pour sceller définitivement le sort de leur manager.

Pour justifier ce choix fort, la direction mancunienne a publié un communiqué sans détour.

Industry observers note that le dernier match de Michael Carrick sur le banc s'est soldé par un match nul spectaculaire (4-4) arraché in extremis contre Aston Villa à Old Trafford dimanche 8 novembre 2026. Un ultime sursaut qui n'a pas suffi à sauver sa place. Manchester United pointe actuellement à une inquiétante 18e place de Premier League en position de relégable, avec un bilan de 8 points et une seule victoire en 10 journées, décrochée fin août face à Ipswich. C'est tout simplement le pire début de saison du club en 40 ans.

According to recent reports, pourtant, le redressement opéré par le technicien avait suscité de grands espoirs quelques mois plus tôt. Nommé sur le banc mancunien en janvier 2026 en succession de Rúben Amorim, Michael Carrick avait hissé l'équipe à la 3e place en remportant 12 de ses 17 derniers matches de la saison 2025-2026. Michael Carrick avait d'ailleurs prolongé son contrat au mois de mai 2026 à la suite de cette qualification en Ligue des champions, avant que la situation ne s'effondre en ce début d'exercice.

Dans son communiqué officiel, le club anglais a également précisé ses intentions pour la suite immédiate de la saison.

D'après les révélations de la presse européenne, Mauricio Pochettino fait figure de grand favori pour s'installer sur le banc et disposerait d'un accord verbal pour succéder à Michael Carrick. L'Argentin, actuellement sélectionneur des États-Unis, n'est toutefois pas encore officiellement nommé. Manchester United doit d'abord s'acquitter d'une clause libératoire estimée à près de 10 millions de dollars, soit environ 9 millions d'euros, afin de libérer le technicien de son contrat américain.

S'il venait à prendre les commandes de l'équipe première, Mauricio Pochettino deviendrait ainsi le 12e entraîneur de Manchester United depuis le départ de Sir Alex Ferguson en 2013. Un chantier colossal attend le futur manager. Le prochain match de Manchester United est programmé le dimanche 22 novembre 2026 à Anfield face à Liverpool pour le compte de la 11e journée de Premier League.

Crystal Palace occupe ainsi la 20e et dernière place du classement, à deux longueurs du premier non-relégable. Une situation critique.

Au total, Pierre Sage n'aura dirigé que 16 matches sur le banc de Crystal Palace toutes compétitions confondues avant son licenciement.

Industry observers note that sur le terrain, la méthode du coach français n'a jamais fonctionné. L'application stricte d'un bloc haut a constamment exposé son arrière-garde, faisant de Crystal Palace la pire défense d'Angleterre avec 24 buts encaissés en 10 matches de championnat. Le mandat de Pierre Sage a notamment été marqué par une lourde défaite (5-0) subie en octobre 2026 face au rival historique Brighton. Un naufrage tactique.

Sources indicate that toutefois, l'effectif a également pâti des départs estivaux non compensés de Maxence Lacroix et Marc Guéhi en défense centrale, dans un contexte de recrutement restreint par une direction plus économe. La succession d'Oliver Glasner s'annonçait d'ailleurs périlleuse, l'Autrichien étant devenu l'idole des supporters après ses victoires en FA Cup et au Community Shield en 2025, puis en Ligue Conférence, avant de rejoindre Nottingham Forest.

Cette éviction intervient alors que Pierre Sage sortait d'une saison brillante au RC Lens, couronnée du titre de meilleur entraîneur de Ligue 1, d'une victoire en Coupe de France et d'une 2e place en championnat. Selon L'Équipe, le technicien pourrait rebondir sans tarder dans le Nord. Il figure parmi les pistes explorées par les dirigeants artésiens, aux côtés de Didier Digard et Thiago Motta, pour succéder à Yannick Cahuzac, limogé en début de semaine.

Sources indicate that de son côté, Crystal Palace négocie activement avec l'entraîneur danois Thomas Frank pour reprendre l'équipe. Les Eagles tenteront de se relancer lors de leur prochain match, programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 15h00 face à Coventry City à la Coventry Building Society Arena, pour le compte de la 11e journée de Premier League.

  • Industry observers note that en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Invité dans le podcast Kampo animé par le journaliste Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry s'est longuement livré sur les coulisses des Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. L'ancien sélectionneur de l'équipe de France olympique a révélé la détermination totale de Michael Olise pour disputer le tournoi sous le maillot tricolore.

Industry observers note that en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore. Le tournoi olympique de football n'étant pas inscrit sur les dates officielles du calendrier de la FIFA, les clubs professionnels n'avaient aucune obligation légale de libérer leurs joueurs. Cette absence de contrainte réglementaire avait grandement compliqué la tâche de Thierry Henry pour composer son groupe. Face à ces nombreux refus, Michael Olise a adopté une démarche diamétralement opposée.

Recent findings suggest that L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique. Alors que Gareth Southgate souhaitait le convoquer avec les A de l'équipe d'Angleterre pour disputer l'Euro 2024, Michael Olise a écarté cette opportunité pour privilégier le maillot tricolore. Le joueur a ainsi multiplié les appels téléphoniques directs avec le sélectionneur français. Dans le podcast Kampo animé par Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry a détaillé cette insistance quotidienne : « Michael, il m’appelait tous les jours pour aller aux JO, alors qu’il y avait l’équipe d’Angleterre qui le voulait pour aller au Championnat d’Europe avec les A. Il aurait pu aller à l’Euro avec l’Angleterre. Mais il m’appelait tous les jours. Son envie de jouer pour l’équipe de France était extraordinaire. Moi, je n’ai convaincu personne. ».

It has been revealed that né à Londres en 2001 d'un père nigérian et d'une mère franco-algérienne, Michael Olise disposait sur le plan sportif de plusieurs options internationales. L'attaquant était éligible pour quatre sélections nationales différentes : la France, l'Angleterre, le Nigeria et l'Algérie. Toutefois, Michael Olise a toujours accordé sa préférence absolue à l'équipe de France. Au-delà des approches anglaises, le joueur a fait preuve d'une fermeté totale au moment de quitter Crystal Palace pour rejoindre l'Allemagne.

It has been revealed that recruté par le Bayern Munich pour 53 millions d'euros selon Foot Mercato, et plus de 60 millions d'euros d'après d'autres sources, il a imposé sa participation aux Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. Le joueur a ainsi pris le risque de se heurter à sa nouvelle direction bavaroise pour défendre les couleurs tricolores. Thierry Henry a salué cette prise de position au micro de Smaïl Bouabdellah : « Michael Olise aime l’équipe de France depuis qu’il est petit. Certains joueurs ne voulaient pas venir. Pas de problème, je n’en veux à personne. Mais un mec de ce calibre est venu, alors qu’il y avait le risque de s’embrouiller avec son nouveau club. Il m’a dit: 'Où je vais, je vais dire à mon club que je vais aux Jeux olympiques, c’est tout.’ On parle de Michael Olise. Mon respect pour lui est énorme. ».

Sur le terrain, ce choix a porté ses fruits tout au long de la compétition estivale. Titulaire lors des 6 matches du tournoi olympique, Michael Olise a compilé 2 buts et 5 passes décisives sous les ordres de Thierry Henry. Ce parcours s'est achevé par une médaille d'argent décrochée le 9 août 2024 au Parc des Princes, après une finale disputée contre l'Espagne (3-5 après prolongation).

According to recent reports, au-delà de ce bilan chiffré, Thierry Henry qualifie Michael Olise de génie qu'il ne faut pas brider. Dans le podcast Kampo, l'ancien joueur d'Arsenal a ainsi développé son analyse sur le talent de son ancien joueur : « Michael, il est à part parce qu’il pense différemment. À un moment donné, les génies, il ne faut pas essayer de les comprendre. C’est un génie ? Ah, de très loin, très très loin. (…) Est-ce que tu vas, toi, dire à un peintre comment peindre ? Pourquoi tu veux bloquer un génie ? ».
